svg.title: The Menu and the Kitchen
svg.desc: A RoboLore instructional graphic comparing a C++ header file to a menu and an implementation file to a kitchen.

path.aria-label: Header declarations tell other files what exists. Implementation code does the work.
It tells you what exists and what to ask for—then stops.
It does not expose the recipe or how the work is performed.
The kitchen is where the work happens.
It contains the loop, encoder counts, motor calls, and trim.
The recipe may change while the menu stays exactly the same.
Long · Private · Only the cook reads it

g.aria-label: When main.cpp calls driveDistance(30), it only needs the declaration.

path.aria-label: An “undefined reference” means the menu promised a function, but the compiler could not find the kitchen behind it.
